subject.title: feat: add runtime self context config and tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's v1 core `runtimeContext` config surface and model-facing `runtime` tool contract after the remaining prompt-summary bug and rebase are fixed, or should the contract be narrowed or paused?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the new config block, tool action shape, prompt exposure modes, and future provider/offload boundary are public product/API choices that automation should not bless alone.

options.title: Approve v1 after repair
options.body: Fix the accelerator-summary bug, rebase cleanly, and accept the additive config/tool contract as the first static runtime self-context slice.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Restrict the schema, exposure modes, or tool actions to the smallest contract maintainers are ready to support now.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Hold this PR until runtime self-context, execution placement, provider refresh, and offload/cost semantics are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve v1 after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the accelerator-summary bug, rebase cleanly, and accept the additive config/tool contract as the first static runtime self-context slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on public config/tool contract direction, and `steipete` has recent history on the adjacent tool catalog and config documentation surfaces.
